The prior range was $100M–$130M; the increase reflects Legacy Stones sales, including the Motswedi and 1,303-carat Type IIa diamonds.
Revenue was $51.2M in Q3 2025; the increase was primarily driven by a 1,303-carat Type IIa diamond sale, a potentially non-recurring contributor.
Higher sales volume supported revenue, though the release does not provide the prior-period carat figure.
This is the project's expected 2026 spending limit; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
Clara sales agreement to end; tenders from Q1 2027
The sales channel change follows Clara revenue falling to $1.4M from $2.0M in Q3 2025.
